decision: Does the plugin produce useful, evidence-bound design outcomes for the visible cases without crossing product, compliance, implementation, or acceptance authority?
population: All frozen qualification-v1 Cascade Design target outputs.

dimensions.description: Correct skill selection and strict separation among mockup authoring, feature UX, accessibility, visual evidence, reusable design rules, product intent, and host implementation/acceptance.

anchors.0: Most cases use the wrong owner or cross authority boundaries.
anchors.1: Several material routing or authority errors make outputs unsafe to use.
anchors.2: Primary routes are often right but recurring collisions or ownership gaps remain.
anchors.3: Routes and boundaries are correct with at most one minor, non-misleading omission.
anchors.4: Every case selects the precise owner, preserves all authority boundaries, and gives exact handoffs without overlap.

dimensions.description: Source identities, conflicts, missing evidence, status, and uncertainty are handled honestly and traceably.

anchors.0: Outputs invent facts, hide missing evidence, or claim unsupported success.
anchors.1: Material sources or gaps are omitted and status is frequently misleading.
anchors.2: Some grounding is present but important conflicts, absent inputs, or evidence classes blur.
anchors.3: Grounding and status are reliable with at most a minor traceability omission.
anchors.4: Every output binds the visible sources, preserves conflicts, exposes gaps/blockers, and never upgrades evidence or status.

dimensions.description: The chosen skill covers applicable design concerns and actionable handoffs. Authoring binds real editable frames, inspected previews and capture conditions when available; read-only planning exposes missing artifacts without fabricating them. Candidate readiness never implies approval or implemented fidelity.

anchors.0: Artifacts are unusable or omit the core design problem.
anchors.1: Most required coverage and evidence planning is absent.
anchors.2: Artifacts address the main issue but omit several material states, checks, constraints, or recovery details.
anchors.3: Artifacts are actionable and substantially complete with at most one minor omission.
anchors.4: Every artifact is concise, schema-coherent, skill-complete, evidence-specific, and gives closed recovery or next-gate detail.

dimensions.description: Outputs remain non-implementing, non-attesting, privacy-aware, and practical for the target owner.

anchors.0: Outputs create material safety, privacy, compliance, or mutation risk.
anchors.1: Several unsafe claims or unauthorized actions remain.
anchors.2: Boundaries are mentioned but inconsistently applied or outputs are hard to act on.
anchors.3: Outputs are safe and usable with at most a minor wording or handoff weakness.
anchors.4: Every output is safely bounded, avoids sensitive persistence and false attestation, and is immediately usable by the named next owner.
